'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**[[2023 Rajouri attacks]]
***Two children are killed and four other people are injured by an [[explosion]] outside the home of one of the four [[Hindus]] who were killed yesterday in [[Rajouri district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/many-killed-in-blast-at-rajouris-dangri-village/article66329258.ece/amp/ (The Hindu)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Two [[firefighter]]s and three [[civilian]]s are killed in an armed attack by [[Islamist]] [[insurgent]]s along a highway between [[Bamako]] and [[Ségou]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/two-firefighters-three-civilians-killed-in-mali-attack-ministry-01672782909 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*Protests continue for a fifth day in [[Las Anod]], [[Somaliland]], with protesters demanding that the city be governed by [[Puntland]] instead of by Somaliland. Twenty people are killed in clashes between protestors and security forces. [https://www.africanews.com/amp/2023/01/02/deadly-clashes-between-protesters-and-security-forces-in-somaliland/ (Africanews)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Gold Coast mid-air collision]]
**Four people are killed and eight others are injured when two helicopters collide near the [[Sea World (Australia)|Sea World]] theme park in [[Gold Coast, Queensland]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-01-02/gold-coast-helicopter-major-incident/101822136 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[New County Hotel fire]]
**Three people are killed after a fire broke out at New County Hotel in [[Perth, Scotland|Perth]], [[Scotland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-tayside-central-64144080 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Malawi]] suspends the opening of schools in [[Lilongwe]] and [[Blantyre]] due to an outbreak of [[cholera]], which has killed 595 people so far, including 19 people on New Year's Eve. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-64144610 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2016 Indian banknote demonetisation]]
**The [[Supreme Court of India]] upholds the legality of the [[Government of India|government]]'s decision to [[Legal tender#Demonetization|demonetise]] all [[Indian 500-rupee note|₹500]] and [[Indian 1000-rupee note|₹1,000]] banknotes of the [[Mahatma Gandhi Series]] in 2016. [https://apnews.com/article/india-government-business-modi-397ca5ebd3084cd57c27f94fbebd8420 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Qatar corruption scandal at the European Parliament]]
**[[President of the European Parliament]] [[Roberta Metsola]] initiates a formal procedure to revoke [[parliamentary immunity]] from two [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]]s allegedly involved in the scandal. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2473675/eu-parliament-chief-moves-to-lift-two-meps-immunity (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 NFL season]]
**[[2022 Buffalo Bills season|Buffalo Bills]] safety [[Damar Hamlin]] suffers from a [[cardiac arrest]] during a ''[[Monday Night Football]]'' game against the [[2022 Cincinnati Bengals season|Cincinnati Bengals]] and is taken to the [[University of Cincinnati Academic Health Center]] by ambulance. The NFL subsequently suspends the game and cancels it three days later.
